research_question: Current real machine body improves action outcome prediction, resource selection and new real-job utility compared with independently trained BLIND and incorrect-time controls.
hypotheses: P1 BODY > independently-trained BLIND on untouched test
P2 BODY > same-task/session/length deranged SHUFFLED on untouched test
P3 BODY > age-aware 30-second STALE on untouched test
P4 BODY > independently-trained BLIND on new live jobs
CF matched-body utility > frozen-action utility with identical prefix history/hidden

wait.limitation: May be dominated for short deadlines; dominance and selection rates reported without adjustment.

latency_definition: dispatch_monotonic to completion_monotonic on same host; full output finite/checksum validation and return transport measured separately, excluded from primary latency
validation_definition: every output matrix element finite; checksum first row against deterministic independent reference; not an elementwise correctness proof

collection.retry_policy: No retries or performance-driven extension; interrupted/invalid sessions are preserved and F2 marked INVALID_COLLECTION. Any recovery or changed scientific protocol requires a separate phase.

normalization_fit: No empirical fit for physical frame; fixed versioned physical constants. Probe feature/target statistics fit from train only.

splits.test_collection_condition: only after passed validation probe and all 24 policy runs frozen; on probe failure D is not collected

probe.standardization: train mean/std; body and interaction feature indices>=6 std floor .05; task/poly6 zero std<1e-8 replaced1
probe.gate: both targets nonconstant in train and validation; for each target validation BODY MAE < BLIND and < SHUFFLED; predicted-utility argmax mean regret BODY < BLIND and < SHUFFLED
probe.selection_accuracy: descriptive secondary; regret is gate metric
probe.test_at_failed_gate: not collected, never opened; no exploratory continuation

policy.loss: teacher cross entropy + expected utility regret
policy.task_order: identical within seed and epoch across modes
policy.checkpoint_selection: first strictly best validation mean utility

shuffle.mapping: bijective derangement to a different block; no self mapping

counterfactual.eligibility: all ordered same-task different-block pairs in held-out D
counterfactual.fork: same weights/task/A prefix history/hidden; swap final body only
counterfactual.outcome: both forked actions scored on B real measured outcome vector; no improving-pair selection

live.shuffle_donors: same-task/same-history-length held-out real body; labels and costs never used for donor choice
live.order_effect: per-position utility/latency and within-mode centered latency by order; descriptive shared-session diagnostic
live.outcome: new numerical jobs on selected physical resource; no replayed reward
live.policy_inference_timing: all four mode actions computed from a common pre-action frame before randomized execution; policy compute time separately recorded and excluded from job latency
live.block_overrun: INVALID_COLLECTION if case begins after the fixed 120s maximum; no reduced cohort or block extension

statistics.sign_test: exact two-sided paired sign test, zeros excluded
statistics.success: each P1-P4 and CF n12 mean>=.01,CI95 lower>0,sign p<=.05; conjunction
statistics.independent_unit: training seed; all seeds share held-out and live workload cohorts
statistics.multiplicity: intersection-union all primary endpoints required; no picking successful comparisons

mac_contribution: No independent MASTER_ONLY training; Mac-unavailable observation OOD only. Additional value remains unverified.

safety.invalid_or_nonfinite_job: abort collection and preserve incomplete records
safety.services: must match initial; unrelated compute is not stopped

prelock_smoke: new synthetic fixtures in work only; no old F data and no fresh confirmatory real acquisition before lock

checksum_tolerance.reference: independent float64 first-row sum from regenerated operands; full matrix finite separate

resource_ood_semantics.controlled_rtx_unavailable: synthetic RTX sensor mask=0 and RTX/WAIT selected outcome failure=-1
resource_ood_semantics.controlled_p100_unavailable: synthetic P100 sensor mask=0 and P100 selected outcome failure=-1
resource_ood_semantics.controlled_cpu_constrained: synthetic CPU sensor mask=0, CPU measured latency x2, original failure flag unchanged
